notes: This portable C++ TCK slice joins a subject with no ordinary object-attribute or interaction subscriptions. A separate requester subscribes to the three standard MIM report interactions and sends HLArequestSubscriptions naming the subject through its inherited HLAfederate parameter. The test verifies the standard empty object-class NULL response, empty interaction-class list, and empty directed-interaction NULL response. It uses only official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, standard encoding DataElements, and the C++ standard library. Provider package, FOM modules, endpoint, callback configuration, names, and logical-time implementation are adapter supplied. No DDM regions, private headers, provider registry, or vendor-specific API are used.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void sendInteraction( InteractionClassHandle const & interactionClass, ParameterHandleValueMap const & parameterValues, VariableLengthData const & userSuppliedTag) = 0
virtual void subscribeInteractionClass( InteractionClassHandle const & interactionClass, bool active = true) = 0
